sections.markdown:
## E — Market signal, Chapter Five, the graduated driver license program

No market research was performed for this section and no competitive intelligence artifact was supplied upstream, so market size, pass rates, candidate rooms, verbatim voice-of-customer phrases, persona, seasonality, pricing, success bar and ad hooks are all recorded as typed debt rather than estimated. The only grounded market observation is scope: the section's rules address first-time Vermont applicants, a yearly cohort of new permit and license seekers, and any later market pack must verify demand against issuer-published candidate counts before quoting a figure.

corpus_stability.reason: The Vermont Driver's Manual is a single pinned edition (Vermont Driver’s Manual 2025; VN-007 07/2024 MTC) revised no more than once a year by the issuer; no faster-changing corpus feeds this section.
